title: Filming: Winter Rose by Wings | 1979
content:
Wings filmed a promotional clip for the Back To The Egg song ‘Winter Rose’ on 13 June 1979.

The shoot took place at Lympne Castle in Kent. It was directed by Keith ‘Keef’ McMillan, who shot promos for several other songs from the Back To The Egg album in the same week.

For the ‘Winter Rose’ video, the castle was shown morphing from spring to winter. The effect was achieved by applying thick layers of soap to the castle, to give the impression of snow. Linda McCartney was also filmed riding a horse to the castle, where she was greeted by Paul McCartney.

A video for ‘Love Awake’ was also supposed to have been filmed on this day, but was postponed until the following day.
